context: A police officer briefs on case-handling
purpose: Teach: リポート/フェーズ/読み取り/近づける/停め/遣っ/戻さ/増えれ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察庁リポート、共有させてください。
lines.en: I'd like to share the National Police Agency report with you.
lines.style: Professional opening. Clear, measured delivery. Even pace. No rush—this is important information being handed over with care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。我々のフェーズ管理、警察と連動させます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll coordinate our phase management with the police operation.
lines.style: Attentive and responsive. Quick acceptance, then slight lean forward into the detail. Shows readiness to execute. Steady confidence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠の読み取り、慎重に。
lines.style: Measured instruction. Light emphasis on 'carefully'—not stern, but weighing. Quiet authority. The tone of someone who has seen carelessness cost.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者に近づけるルート、限定されています。
lines.en: Understood. Our routes to approach the suspect are limited.
lines.style: Factual acknowledgment. Brief pause before 'limited'—registering the constraint. Professional but not robotic. Shows he's thinking through the logistics.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 車両、現場の入口で停めるよう、お願いします。
lines.en: Please make sure vehicles are parked at the site entrance only.
lines.style: Directive stated as respectful request. Clear, no ambiguity. Slight downward inflection at the end. The politeness of someone used to being followed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報、警察と社員、業務を遣ってもらう体制を進めます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll move forward with coordinating PR and staff deployment with your department.
lines.style: Confirming and forward-moving. Slight uptick at 'PR'—showing he's already thinking ahead to the next layer. Efficient, not rushed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠、白紙に戻さず、追跡を。
lines.en: Don't reset the evidence chain. Keep tracking it.
lines.style: Firm instruction. Slight stress on 'don't' and 'keep'—non-negotiable. The tone of someone protecting the integrity of an investigation. Still measured, not angry.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事案、増えれば、対策も強化します。
lines.en: Understood. If more cases emerge, we'll escalate our countermeasures accordingly.
lines.style: Closing statement with future readiness. Calm, steady. No drama. Shows he understands this might expand and is prepared. Professional handoff tone.
